verdict.rationale: Goodwin documents a dedicated Patent Prosecution + Counseling practice group page that draws on more than 100 IP specialists and covers procuring patent rights and proactive counsel on others' patent rights. That satisfies the documented-practice and group-page parts of the story. However, the evidence does not explicitly describe drafting and filing applications or portfolio-building strategy, and names no individual practitioners. missing for 10: explicit drafting/filing of applications, documented portfolio strategy or defensible-position building, named patent practitioners, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: Goodwin's Patent Prosecution + Counseling Practice draws from more than 100 intellectual property specialists across the firm... procuring and enforcing patent rights, providing proactive counsel to determine the patent rights of others.
